name: spec-kit
description: GitHub's spec-driven development toolkit. Provides /speckit:specify, /speckit:plan, /speckit:tasks, and /speckit:implement slash commands that guide an agent from a written specification through planning, task breakdown, and implementation. Works with any existing repository (greenfield or brownfield). Installed once by a System Admin, then activated per Agent Team via a grant. Content is fetched from GitHub at install time and pinned to a specific version; upgrading requires a deliberate re-install. Offline installs are not supported.
promptLine: You have spec-kit slash commands for spec-driven development: `/speckit:specify` (author spec.md), `/speckit:plan` (produce plan.md), `/speckit:tasks` (break down into tasks.md), `/speckit:implement` (execute the plan). Run these in order to drive a feature from specification through to code. The `.specify/` scaffold they depend on is seeded into your workspace root; run the commands from there.
